# Jian Adornado — Data Visualization Product Designer

> Jian Adornado is a Principal Product Designer specializing in data visualization, AI-native product design, and building data products end to end. Currently at Ōura (health insights and AI-native design). Previously Netflix, Uber, Amazon, Dropbox, Motive, and founding designer roles in fintech.

## Positioning
- Data visualization product designer
- AI-native designer (products and workflows built with AI as part of the foundation)
- Product builder: ships tools used by operators, analysts, and decision-makers — not decks alone

## Expertise
- Data visualization and monitoring dashboards
- AI-native product design and human–AI interaction

- Design systems for charts, maps, and operational interfaces
- Turning complex data into clear, actionable insights
- Founding / 0→1 product design and design leadership
